dct_description_sm:
see also Lake Babine Nation Ne-Tsaw-Greece 10 Reserve, 1899_2024
https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/GUTJND

Georeferenced map of Lake Babine Nation Tsak 9 reserve clipped from original Plan No. 3 of the Hagwilget Indian Reserves, Cassiar District (https://doi.org/10.58066/662g-j470). It is located south east of Morrison Lake. Land cover and features include types of trees and soil.
